purpose: Mechanism verification with scripted outcomes; not evidence of learning efficacy or calibrated recall probabilities.

checks.name: Unobserved time decreases predicted recall without mutating the card
A previously stable word becomes due without an additional failure
An unassessed new word has unknown recall, not a measured zero
Late success uses the actual elapsed interval
An observed failure changes stability and adds one lapse
After 100 studied words, a one-word budget selects only one target
The 99 unselected words retain all real dates, counts and memory states
A zero-word day produces no selection or memory change
After a 20-day absence the current queue can be rebuilt without resetting history
A stale plan is not the complete candidate set after a long interruption
The persisted fifth-target slot protects an older word even with one word per session
A supported practice moves the fairness turn without changing the memory due date
A taught but unassessed word can be selected without fabricating a recall probability
An unassessed word can reach a fairness slot even with an existing review backlog
Retrying the same answer does not apply a second FSRS update
Copying after reveal and uncertain grading preserve evidence without changing FSRS
Exiting after three of five leaves the group partial and preserves three completed targets
A one-word continuation can resume the same group without requiring the other four
Completing meaning recall does not update an untested spelling state
